display_name: Formic acid dimer double proton transfer
description: Hydrogen-bonded dimer sample with curated gas-phase and aqueous activation-free-energy references.
recommended_use: Double proton-transfer and activation-free-energy comparison sample.

reference_values.method: Biased NVE simulation with ML potential energy surface for formic acid dimer
reference_values.note: This is the closest free-energy activation reference for the isolated dimer found in the open article.

reference_values.method: Biased simulation in water with fluctuating charges on formic acid dimer
reference_values.note: Solution reference; useful only if the MolScout workflow includes comparable solvent treatment.

reference_values.method: Biased simulation in water with fixed charges on formic acid dimer
reference_values.note: Alternative charge model from the same study.

reference_values.method: PhysNet ML potential energy surface trained to MP2 reference data
reference_values.note: Potential barrier, not Delta G activation.

toepfer_2022_pccp.citation: K. Toepfer, S. Kaeser, and M. Meuwly, Double proton transfer in hydrated formic acid dimer: Interplay of spatial symmetry and solvent-generated force on reactivity, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2022.

curation_note: The gas-phase free-energy value at 310 K is likely the most relevant value for the existing isolated-dimer sample. Do not compare the aqueous values to a gas-phase calculation.
